<sql>
**Session database** (database: "session", the default):
The per-session database persists across the session but is isolated from other sessions.

Use SQL for structured operational data such as todo lists, test cases, batch items, and session state.

**Pre-existing tables (ready to use):**
- `todos`: id, title, description, status (pending/in_progress/done/blocked), created_at, updated_at
- `todo_deps`: todo_id, depends_on (for dependency tracking)

**Todo tracking:**
Use descriptive kebab-case IDs (not t1, t2). Write titles in gerund form (e.g. "Creating user auth module"). Include enough detail that the todo can be executed without referring back to the plan:
```sql
INSERT INTO todos (id, title, description) VALUES
  ('user-auth', 'Creating user auth module', 'Implement JWT auth in src/auth/ so login, logout, and token refresh don''t depend on server sessions. Use bcrypt for password hashing.');
```

**Todo status:**
- `pending`: Todo is waiting to be started
- `in_progress`: You are actively working on this todo (set this before starting!)
- `done`: Todo is complete
- `blocked`: Todo cannot proceed (document why in description)

**Dependencies:** Insert into todo_deps when one todo must complete before another:
```sql

arguments.prompt:
Read the file "c:\Users\PKBJE\OneDrive - Ørsted\Documents - Sapvedligehold\SAP\SAP Site\html\js\app-vh-plan.js" (2349 lines) in full (use view with view_range in chunks of ~300 lines to cover the whole file).

This is the JS behind an HTML page "vh-plan.html" that manages SAP Maintenance Plans (VH-plan = Vedligeholdelsesplan) with Plan Header, Items, Tasklist/Operations, and Dispatch/mail-draft steps.

Produce a DETAILED summary covering:
1. Overall data model: what fields exist on the "Plan" object, the "Item" object (per item in items rail), and "Operation" rows (tasklist lines bound to an item).
2. State management: what global/module state variables exist (e.g. current plan, items list, selected item id, lock state, validation state, mode drift/etc.)
3. Validation logic: what fields are required, what validation rules are applied when clicking "Validate" or "Save", and what error messages look like.
4. Plan lock behavior: how "vhPlanLockState" works - what can/can't be edited before/after plan is saved/locked.
5. Item rail (left list) behavior: add item, copy item, remove item, select item - how the UI updates, how items are numbered/keyed.
6. Functional Location (FL) combobox/autocomplete logic: how vhFlSuggestions works, verify FL in SAP button behavior, vhFlMeta / vhFlDescription content, detected plant from FL.
7. Tasklist logic: itemTasklistSelect dropdown - how tasklist options are sourced from vh-tasklist-data.js, "Apply tasklist" button behavior, "Add lines from tasklist" and the tasklist picker modal (search/filter, select all, select individual rows, "Add selected lines") - how operation rows get created/merged into vhOperationsBody table with columns Sel/Op No/Operation Short Text/Work(H)/Dur(H)/Main Work Center/Vendor/Long Text.
8. Add operation / Remove operation manual buttons behavior.
9. Export JSON / "Send as email" (mailto) behavior - what data goes into the export and the mail draft, format used.
10. Any options data used from vh-plan-options.js (dropdown option lists like Status, Unit, Call Horizon, Sort Field, Main Work Center - Item, Main work center - Taskliste, Maintenance activity type, Revision) - map which dropdown in HTML uses which options key.
11. Any interesting helper functions (formatting, id generation, csv/collection helpers) worth replicating in Power Apps formulas.
12. Runtime info / status message logic (vhRuntimeInfo, vhPlanStatusInline, vhOptionsState, vhPlanMeta, vhItemMeta, vhTasklistMeta) - when do these get updated and with what text.

Be thorough and include actual field names, button ids, and message strings verbatim where possible, since this will be used to rebuild equivalent functionality as a Power Apps Canvas App. Return a long structured report, not a short summary.

| itemTasklistSelect | `<select>` | (n/a) | (populated dynamically) | Populated from `state.tasklists[plant]` |

**Options Loading** (`loadOptions()`, `resolveVhOptionsPayload()`):
- First checks `window.VH_PLAN_OPTIONS_DATA` (if pre-loaded)
- Falls back to fetch `js/data/vh-plan-options.json` with cache-busting: `{ cache: "no-cache" }`
- Sets `state.optionsLoaded = true` on success
- On failure: sets `state.optionsLoaded = false`, uses hardcoded fallback values
- Updates `dom.optionsState` element:
  - Success: empty (class "inline-helper")
  - Failure: "Dropdown data could not be loaded. Fallback values are in use." (class "inline-helper warn")

**Tasklists Loading** (`loadTasklists()`, `resolveTasklistPayload()`):
- First checks `window.VH_TASKLIST_DATA` (if pre-loaded)
- Falls back to fetch `js/data/vh-tasklist-data.json` with cache-busting
- Expects response structure: `{ plants: { PLANT_CODE: { tasklists: [...], sourceSheet, sheetCode }, ... }, source, version }`
- Sets `state.tasklistsLoaded`, `state.tasklistSource`, `state.tasklistVersion`
- Updates `dom.tasklistMeta` element:
  - Success: `"Tasklists loaded from {source}."` (class "inline-helper ok")
  - Failure: `"Tasklists not available. Use custom operations."` (class "inline-helper warn")

**Styled Select Enhancement** (`enhanceSelect()`, `setupStyledSelects()`):
- Wraps native `<select>` elements with custom styled dropdown UI
- Creates wrapper div + trigger button + panel with options
- Applied to: planPlant, planStatus, planSortField, planUnit, planCallHorizon, itemMainWorkCenter, itemActivityType, itemRevision, itemTasklistSelect
- Prevents default HTML select dropdown in favor of custom styled panel
- Tracks in `state.styledSelects[]` array for centralized management

### 11. HELPER FUNCTIONS (Useful for Power Apps Implementation)

#### **Text Utilities** (from `window.TextUtils`)
```javascript
// Imported functions
const { toText, normalizeUpper, clipText, escapeHtml } = window.TextUtils;
```

- **`toText(value)`** – Safely converts any value to string; handles null/undefined → ""
- **`normalizeUpper(value)`** – Upper-case conversion
- **`clipText(text, maxLength)`** – Truncates text with ellipsis
- **`escapeHtml(text)`** – HTML-encodes special characters for safe rendering

#### **Collection Helpers**

**`dedupe(messages)`** – Removes duplicate strings from array
```javascript
function dedupe(messages) {
  const set = new Set();
  messages.forEach((value) => {
    const text = toText(value);
    if (text) set.add(text);
  });
  return Array.from(set.values());
}
```
Used for: Deduplicating validation issue/warning messages

**`normalizeOperationNo(value, pad)`** – Normalizes operation number
```javascript
function normalizeOperationNo(value, pad) {
  const digits = toText(value).replace(/[^0-9]/g, "").slice(0, 4);
  if (!digits) return "";
  if (!pad) return digits;
  return digits.padStart(4, "0");
}
```
- Strips non-digit chars, limits to 4 digits
- `pad=true` → returns "0010", "0020", etc.
- `pad=false` → returns "10", "20", etc.

**`normalizeFunctionalLocation(value)`** – Normalizes FL codes
```javascript
function normalizeFunctionalLocation(value) {
  return String(value == null ? "" : value)
    .replaceAll("\u00A0", " ")        // Non-breaking space → space
    .replaceAll("\r", "")              // Remove carriage return
    .replaceAll("\n", "")              // Remove newline
    .trim()
    .toUpperCase();
}
```

**`upperCaseFlInputInPlace()`** – Upper-cases FL input WITHOUT trimming spaces inside
```javascript
function upperCaseFlInputInPlace() {
  const input = dom.itemFunctionalLocation;
  const next = String(input.value)
    .replaceAll("\u00A0", " ")
    .replace(/[\r\n]/g, "")
    .toUpperCase();
  
  if (next === input.value) return;
  
  const caret = input.selectionStart;
  input.value = next;
  if (caret !== null) {
    input.setSelectionRange(caret, caret);
  }
}
```
Called on every input event of FL field to maintain uppercase while preserving cursor position

**`isPositiveNumber(value)`** – Validates positive decimal numbers
```javascript
function isPositiveNumber(value) {
  const text = toText(value).replace(",", ".");  // Accept comma as decimal
  const num = Number(text);
  return Number.isFinite(num) && num > 0;
}
```
Used for: workHours, durationHours validation

**`nextOperationNumber(operations)`** – Generates next operation number
```javascript
function nextOperationNumber(operations) {
  let max = 0;
  operations.forEach((operation) => {
    const value = Number.parseInt(toText(operation.operationNo), 10);
    if (Number.isFinite(value) && value > max) {
      max = value;
    }
  });
  const next = max > 0 ? max + 10 : 10;
  return String(next).padStart(4, "0");
}
```
Example: If ops are [0010, 0020], next is "0030"

**`formatFieldLine(label, value)`** – Formats field display for email
```javascript
function formatFieldLine(label, value) {
  const left = toText(label) || "-";
  const right = toText(value) || "-";
  return `${left.padEnd(30, " ")}: ${right}`;
}
```
Output: `"Plant                        : ASV"`

#### **Tasklist Helper Functions**

**`getTasklistsForPlant(plantCode)`** – Returns array of tasklists for a plant
```javascript
function getTasklistsForPlant(plantCode) {
  const key = toText(plantCode).toUpperCase();
  if (!key || !state.tasklists[key]) return [];
  const tasklists = state.tasklists[key].tasklists;
  return Array.isArray(tasklists) ? tasklists : [];
}
```

**`getDefaultTasklistForPlant(plantCode)`** – Returns first non-CUSTOM tasklist (or first if all custom)
```javascript
function getDefaultTasklistForPlant(plantCode) {
  const tasklists = getTasklistsForPlant(plantCode);
  if (!tasklists.length) return null;
  const preferred = tasklists.find((tasklist) => !tasklist.key.endsWith("-CUSTOM"));
  return preferred || tasklists[0];
}
```
Used when creating new items to auto-bind default tasklist

**`getTasklistByKey(plantCode, tasklistKey)`** – Looks up specific tasklist
```javascript
function getTasklistByKey(plantCode, tasklistKey) {
  const key = toText(tasklistKey);
  if (!key) return null;
  const tasklists = getTasklistsForPlant(plantCode);
  return tasklists.find((tasklist) => tasklist.key === key) || null;
}
```

**`getActiveItem()`** – Returns current active item or null
```javascript
function getActiveItem() {
  return state.items.find((item) => item.id === state.activeItemId) || null;
}
```

#### **Process Step States** (`dom.stepPlan/Item/Tasklist/Operations/Dispatch`)
**Visual indicator of workflow progress.**

5 steps defined:
1. Plan header
2. Item details
3. Tasklist binding
4. Operations/tasklist lines
5. Dispatch/email (validation complete)

Each step can have classes:
- "done" – completed (step number < current step)
- "active" – current (step number === current step) + aria-current="step"
- "upcoming" – not yet (step number > current step)

**Step Determination** (`getCurrentProcessStep()`):
```
1: planCommitted === false
2: planCommitted && (!activeItem || !activeItem.committed || !activeItem.locked)
3: (plan committed && item locked) && !activeItem.tasklistKey
4: (plan committed && item locked && tasklist bound) && !activeItem.operations.length
5: Everything completed (plan, item, tasklist, operations)
```

### 15. INITIALIZATION SEQUENCE

```javascript
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", init);

async function init() {
  bindDom();                              // 1. Cache all DOM element references
  bindEvents();                           // 2. Attach event listeners
  setupStyledSelects();                   // 3. Enhance select dropdowns
  
  updateProxyButton();                    // 4. Set proxy button initial state
  setRuntime("Loading options and tasklists...");
  
  await Promise.all([                     // 5. Load external data (parallel)
    loadOptions(),                        // → vh-plan-options.json
    loadTasklists()                       // → vh-tasklist-data.json
  ]);
  
  syncPlanToForm();                       // 6. Populate form from state
  renderItemRail();                       // 7. Render item cards
  loadActiveItemIntoEditor();             // 8. Load first/active item into editor
  renderTasklistControls();               // 9. Populate tasklist dropdown
  applyPlanInteractionState();            // 10. Update all button states & styling
  
  setRuntime("Fill plan data, then click Save.");
}
```

### 16. KEYBOARD SHORTCUTS & INTERACTION PATTERNS

#### **FL Autocomplete Keyboard Handling** (`onFlKeyDown()`)
- **Escape** → Close suggestions
- **ArrowUp** / **ArrowDown** → Navigate suggestions (circular)
- **Enter** → Select active suggestion
- **Blur event** → Close suggestions, trigger exact lookup via `lookupExactFlForActiveItem()`

#### **Tasklist Picker Modal**
- **Escape** → Close modal (bound at document level)
- **Click outside modal** → Close (via `data-modal-close` attribute)
- **Search input changes** → Filter tasklist rows in real-time
- **Select All checkbox** → Toggle all visible rows
- **Individual row click** → Toggle checkbox (click anywhere on row)
- **Row checkbox change** → Update individual selection

#### **Item Rail Navigation**
- **Click item card** → Switch active item (calls `persistEditorToActiveItem()` first)

#### **Operations Table**
- **Click select button** → Mark row as active (visual state)
- **Inline edit any field** → Auto-saves to operation object (no submit needed)
- **operationNo field blur** → Normalizes to 4-digit padded format

#### **Plan Plant Change**
- **Change planPlant select** → Triggers several actions:
  - `applyPlantPrefixToPlanText()` – Auto-prefixes planText with new plant code
  - If `planCommitted && !planLocked` → Message: "Plant changed in edit mode. Save the plan again to apply tasklist rebinding."
  - If plant changed on locked plan → Prompts confirmation dialog for rebinding all items

### 22. ERROR HANDLING & EDGE CASES

#### **Plan-Level Error Scenarios**

| Scenario | Handler | User Message |
|---|---|---|
| Plant changed, items exist | Confirmation dialog + rebinding | "Plant changed from X to Y. This will rebind tasklists..." |
| Plan not committed | Validation prevents save | "Plan contains issues. Fix plan fields before creating items." |
| Cycle not a valid number | Validation error | "Cycle must be a positive number." |
| First call date out of range | Validation error | "First call day must be 1..31." |
| Options load fails | Fallback to hardcoded | "Dropdown data could not be loaded. Fallback values are in use." |
| Tasklist data missing | Warning, allow custom ops | "Tasklists not available. Use custom operations." |

#### **Item-Level Error Scenarios**

| Scenario | Handler | User Message |
|---|---|---|
| Item deleted while editing | Reset editor, show first item | (implicit via renderItemRail re-sync) |
| FL lookup timeout | Catch error, display formatted message | "SAP lookup timeout. Check network..." |
| FL not found in SAP | Mark as warning | "Functional Location not found in SAP OData." |
| Item locked, trying to edit | Button text changes to "Edit", fields disabled | "Item saved. Click Edit to change item fields." |
| Copy item clears FL | Intentional, inform user | "Item copied. Functional Location cleared on copied item." |

#### **Operation-Level Error Scenarios**

| Scenario | Handler | User Message |
|---|---|---|
| Duplicate operation numbers | Validation error | "Operation 2: duplicate operation no. 0010." |
| Operation no not 4 digits | Validation error, pad on blur | "Operation 1: operation no. must be 4 digits." |
| Work hours not positive | Validation error | "Operation 1: Work (H) must be a positive number." |
| PM02/PM03 without vendor | Validation warning (non-blocking) | "Operation 1: Vendor should be filled for PM02." |
| Removing last operation | Mark item as draft, disable remove button | activeOperationIndex set to -1 |

#### **Network & Integration Scenarios**

| Scenario | Handler | User Message |
|---|---|---|
| SAP OData unavailable | Catch connection error | `OrstedOData.formatLookupError()` (formatted error from network library) |
| FL search cancelled (old request) | Token-based cancellation | (Silent cancellation, no error shown) |
| Mailto too long | Truncate to summary mode | "Aabner mailkladde i mailklient. Afkortet oversigt..." |
| Email function unavailable | Catch missing window.MailtoUtils | "Mailfunktion er ikke tilgaengelig." |
| Local proxy toggle | Simple state flip, no validation | "Proxy ON" / "Proxy OFF" (runtime message) |

#### **Validation Flow with Recovery**

```
User clicks "Save Plan"
  ↓
collectPlanIssues(plan) → [list of errors]
  ↓
If errors.length > 0:
  - Disable save button
  - Display first error in dom.planMeta (red)
  - Show message: "Plan contains issues. Fix plan fields before creating items."
  - User fixes fields
  - collectPlanIssues() re-runs (triggered by input/change events)

```

### 22. ERROR HANDLING & EDGE CASES

#### **Plan-Level Error Scenarios**

| Scenario | Handler | User Message |
|---|---|---|
| Plant changed, items exist | Confirmation dialog + rebinding | "Plant changed from X to Y. This will rebind tasklists..." |
| Plan not committed | Validation prevents save | "Plan contains issues. Fix plan fields before creating items." |
| Cycle not a valid number | Validation error | "Cycle must be a positive number." |
| First call date out of range | Validation error | "First call day must be 1..31." |
| Options load fails | Fallback to hardcoded | "Dropdown data could not be loaded. Fallback values are in use." |
| Tasklist data missing | Warning, allow custom ops | "Tasklists not available. Use custom operations." |

#### **Item-Level Error Scenarios**

| Scenario | Handler | User Message |
|---|---|---|
| Item deleted while editing | Reset editor, show first item | (implicit via renderItemRail re-sync) |
| FL lookup timeout | Catch error, display formatted message | "SAP lookup timeout. Check network..." |
| FL not found in SAP | Mark as warning | "Functional Location not found in SAP OData." |
| Item locked, trying to edit | Button text changes to "Edit", fields disabled | "Item saved. Click Edit to change item fields." |
| Copy item clears FL | Intentional, inform user | "Item copied. Functional Location cleared on copied item." |

#### **Operation-Level Error Scenarios**

| Scenario | Handler | User Message |
|---|---|---|
| Duplicate operation numbers | Validation error | "Operation 2: duplicate operation no. 0010." |
| Operation no not 4 digits | Validation error, pad on blur | "Operation 1: operation no. must be 4 digits." |
| Work hours not positive | Validation error | "Operation 1: Work (H) must be a positive number." |
| PM02/PM03 without vendor | Validation warning (non-blocking) | "Operation 1: Vendor should be filled for PM02." |
| Removing last operation | Mark item as draft, disable remove button | activeOperationIndex set to -1 |

#### **Network & Integration Scenarios**

| Scenario | Handler | User Message |
|---|---|---|
| SAP OData unavailable | Catch connection error | `OrstedOData.formatLookupError()` (formatted error from network library) |
| FL search cancelled (old request) | Token-based cancellation | (Silent cancellation, no error shown) |
| Mailto too long | Truncate to summary mode | "Aabner mailkladde i mailklient. Afkortet oversigt..." |
| Email function unavailable | Catch missing window.MailtoUtils | "Mailfunktion er ikke tilgaengelig." |
| Local proxy toggle | Simple state flip, no validation | "Proxy ON" / "Proxy OFF" (runtime message) |

#### **Validation Flow with Recovery**

```
User clicks "Save Plan"
  ↓
collectPlanIssues(plan) → [list of errors]
  ↓
If errors.length > 0:
  - Disable save button
  - Display first error in dom.planMeta (red)
  - Show message: "Plan contains issues. Fix plan fields before creating items."
  - User fixes fields
  - collectPlanIssues() re-runs (triggered by input/change events)
  - If errors clear → save button re-enabled
  ↓
Else (no errors):
  - Enable save button
  - User clicks save
  - commitPlanAndCreateFirstItem()
  - Create first item
  - Set planCommitted = true, planLocked = true
  - Message: "Plan saved. Fill in the item fields and save the item."
  - Item rail renders with 1 item
  - Item form loaded
  - Focus shifts to item short text input
```

### 24. SUMMARY OF KEY DIFFERENCES FROM NATIVE SAP UI

| Feature | This Web Shell | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| **State Model** | Fully client-side (no backend) | All data in memory (state object) |
| **Persistence** | Export JSON or email draft | No database save; user exports to use in SAP |
| **Validation** | Real-time + batch | Validates on input (error display) and on "Validate" button (SAP lookups) |
| **FL Lookup** | Async autocomplete + exact lookup | Debounced search (7+ chars) + explicit "Verify" button |
| **Tasklist Binding** | Per-item with modal picker | Select dropdown, then "Apply" to bind; use modal to add individual lines |
| **Operations Numbering** | Auto-generated 4-digit | Starts at 0010, increments by 10 |
| **Plant Rebinding** | Explicit confirmation dialog | Changing plant on locked plan rebinds/clears all items' tasklists |
| **Email** | Mailto link with subject/body | Danish language; truncates if URL > 1850 chars |
| **Proxy Toggle** | Hardcoded button | Switch between local proxy and direct SAP connection |
| **Offline Support** | Options/tasklist cached in JSON | Can work offline if data pre-loaded |

### 19. CRITICAL INTEGRATION POINTS FOR POWER APPS - CONTINUED

6. **Date/Time Handling**:
   - First call date built from `firstCallDay`, `firstCallMonth`, `firstCallYear` fields
   - Email timestamp via `Today()` / `Now()`
   - Export filename uses ISO timestamp format: `TEXT(Now(), "yyyy-mm-dd-hh-mm-ss")`

I'll scope the Canvas App build starting with App.pa.yaml, seeding collections on start.

I'll seed all the dropdown option collections, sample/summarize the large tasklist dataset since it's too big to use fully, and set up an empty items table plus plan record variables. Then I'll build ScreenVhPlan mirroring the HTML sections -- hero header with title, buttons, process strip and runtime bar, followed by the Plan Header section with all its fields and controls, and then the Items rail plus item editor layout.

For the item editor I'll include the FL fields with a verify button, dropdowns for work center and activity type, and a long text field, plus a Tasklist and Operations section with its own dropdown, action buttons, and an operations table, along with a Dispatch and Control status area and a floating email button. I'm also planning a tasklist picker modal as an overlay with search, select-all, a checkbox table, and action buttons, and I'll implement the whole thing as a single cohesive screen given the complexity.

Rather than manually authoring all this YAML by hand, I'm leaning toward using the canvas-authoring MCP tools to connect directly to the Power App and edit it through its native capabilities.

Actually, the coauthoring flow likely works by pulling the YAML representation locally, letting me edit it directly, and syncing changes back to the browser session automatically or via sync_canvas. import json, re

src = r"c:\Users\PKBJE\OneDrive - Ørsted\Documents - Sapvedligehold\SAP\SAP Site\html\js\data\vh-tasklist-data.js"
with open(src, encoding="utf-8-sig") as f:
    raw = f.read()

raw = re.sub(r'^window\.VH_TASKLIST_DATA\s*=\s*', '', raw.strip())
raw = re.sub(r';\s*$', '', raw)
data = json.loads(raw)

def esc(s):
    if s is None:
        return ""
    s = str(s)
    s = s.replace('"', '""')
    return s

def numlit(s):
    # numeric literal for workHours/durationHours; fallback to 0
    if s is None or str(s).strip() == "":
        return "0"
    try:
        f = float(s)
        if f == int(f):
            return str(int(f))
        return str(f)
    except ValueError:
        return "0"

lines = []
lines.append("ClearCollect(")
lines.append("    colTasklists,")
lines.append("    Table(")

plant_entries = []
for plant_code, plant_obj in data["plants"].items():
    for tl in plant_obj["tasklists"]:
        ops = tl.get("operations", [])
        op_records = []
        for op in ops:
            rec = (
                '{ OperationNo: "' + esc(op.get("operationNo")) + '", '
                'OperationShortText: "' + esc(op.get("operationShortText")) + '", '

data.reasoningText:
Now I need to plan the full App.pa.yaml OnStart section, matching the YAML block scalar indentation style used in the existing file where OnStart is indented under Properties and its content follows a consistent nested indent.

I'm sketching the data model: collections for tasklists, various option lists (plan status, yes/no, units, order types, work centers, sort fields, priority, revision, activity type, control, call horizon, doc system), plant codes matching the Materialer app's plant list with FL-to-plant-name mapping, and an empty item collection schema with ItemId, ShortText, and Function fields.

I'm continuing that item schema with FlLocation, FlDescription, MainWorkCenter, ActivityType, ObjectList, Revision, responsible party, initials, long text, tasklist key/name, locked/committed flags, status, and created order for numbering. Since items nest an operations table, I'm figuring out how to initialize this typed collection in Power Fx — likely seeding it with a sample record shaping the full schema, then clearing just the rows while preserving the structure.

Looking at existing patterns like colMaterialRows with its 3 seed rows, I'm leaning toward seeding VH-plan with 1-2 demo items for immediate visual verification while building, mirroring the Materialer approach so it stays consistent with "same style." Given the nested structure (Operations nested inside Items), I need to think through how Power Apps galleries handle that nesting.

Rather than binding a nested gallery directly to a table field on ThisItem, which gets complicated when patching individual rows, it's simpler to maintain two flat collections instead: colItems for one row per item, and colOperations for one row per operation linked back via an ItemId foreign key.

This flat relational design is more idiomatic for Canvas Apps and far more reliable for Patch/Filter/Remove operations than trying to mutate nested tables in place. I'm deviating from the original JS's nested object model here, but it's the correct approach for Power Fx — nested table patches are notoriously fragile. The colTasklists reference data can stay nested since it's read-only.

Now I'm working out the plan-level global variables I need: tracking whether the plan header has been committed and locked, plus fields for plant, status, text, and sort field, mirroring how the VH-plan section manages its own state separately from the materials section (no mode toggle needed here since there's no drift/projekt distinction).

Rather than proliferating separate global variables for every input (cycle, unit, call horizon, scheduling indicator, first-call day/month/year, statutory sort field), I'm deciding to follow the Materialer pattern: use varFormXxx purely as Default binding sources for pre-filling controls on edit, and read the live values directly from the control's .Text/.Selected property at save time instead of syncing everything into intermediate variables.

Since Plan is a single record rather than a list, I don't need a gallery -- I can just use a single record variable, varPlan, with fields for Plant, Status, PlanText, SortField, Cycle, Unit, CallHorizon, SchedulingIndicator, FirstCallDay, FirstCallMonth, FirstCallYear, and StatutorySortField, which is cleaner than a one-row collection.

I also need supporting state: varPlanLocked and varPlanCommitted as booleans, varActiveItemId for the selected item in the editor/tasklist, counters varNextItemId and varNextOpId for generating new row IDs, and validation flags like varValidated (or split into varPlanValidated, varItemValidated, varOpValidated) mirroring the pattern from Materialer to control error display when Save/Validate is clicked.

I'll add text fields for messages too: varRuntimeInfo for the top status bar, varPlanLockMessage for lock state, varLastValidationErrors for the full multi-line validation report, varTasklistMeta for tasklist binding status, and a FL lookup mechanism (varFlMeta/varFlDescription) backed by a static table since there's no real SAP connector.

Since Verify FL needs sample data to feel functional, I'll seed colFunctionalLocations with sample FL codes and descriptions across plants, reusing plant conventions from the materials sample data. I'll also add tasklist picker state -- a visibility flag, a search-bound text input, and a selection collection for tracking chosen picker items.

For selection, I'll use colPickerSelected keyed by OperationNo since it's unique within a tasklist, with simple toggle logic for adding/removing rows. I'll skip building undo/snapshot handling for item removal since it's outside core scope, but I do plan an export flow -- a button that builds a JSON-style text via concatenation and stores it in varExportJson for display, mirroring the CSV export pattern elsewhere, plus a send-as-email button that constructs a mailto link.

Let me check whether Materialer already has a similar mailto pattern around its send-email button, so I can reuse that formula structure instead of writing it from scratch.

data.reasoningText:
Good, this confirms the modal overlay is positioned absolutely with X/Y as a sibling of conMatRoot in the Screen's top-level children, not nested inside the AutoLayout container, with its visibility bound to a condition. This shows a Screen's children array can mix an AutoLayout root container alongside free-floating absolutely-positioned overlays.

Now I have enough to design the full YAML structure: App.pa.yaml will handle OnStart seeding of collections, demo items/operations, and initial plan state, pointing to ScreenVhPlan as the start screen. ScreenVhPlan itself will be built as a scrollable vertical root container holding a hero section (title, actions, process strip, legend), a plan header card, a two-column items/editor split section, and a tasklist/operations section.

For the operations table, I'm making the editable fields (short text, work hours, duration, work center dropdown, vendor, long text) bound to modern inputs with Patch-on-change, plus a selection checkbox and a padded operation number label. I'm also adding a dispatch/control status card, a floating email button, and a tasklist picker modal with search, select-all, and a gallery table.

Given the scale of this YAML (likely thousands of lines), I'll build it incrementally in sections using consistent patterns from existing screens, compiling after each major piece to catch errors early rather than waiting until the end.

Actually, incremental edits with unique anchors are cumbersome for this much new content—it's simpler to assemble the complete YAML directly, since I already understand the syntax well, then compile and fix any issues afterward. I'll write the full file content directly rather than trying to pipe it through a script into the create tool.

I'll write a Python generator that outputs valid YAML for the entire screen, matching the patterns I've learned, and save it straight to ScreenVhPlan.pa.yaml—then validate with compile_canvas and iterate on the generator if errors show up. This is more robust than hand-assembling giant YAML and risking indentation mistakes. First I need to nail down the field lists and naming conventions, using a "vhp" prefix for VhPlan controls to avoid collisions.

Now I'm listing out every control needed for the hero section: eyebrow, title, subtitle text elements, validate and export buttons, plus a five-step process strip (Plan/Item/Tasklist/Operations/Dispatch) that highlights the current step based on computed state like plan commitment, active item, tasklist application, and operations progress.

I decide to track the current step with an explicit global variable set imperatively at each relevant button's OnSelect, rather than recomputing it reactively -- simpler to reason about. I also need a runtime status text and a required-fields legend widget matching the Materialer pattern.

Moving into the Plan Header section, I'm laying out its header title, description, a "Step 1" badge, and a plan lock indicator.

Now I'm mapping out the field grid for the plan card, following the HTML order: Plant dropdown bound to plant codes (required), Status dropdown (required), Plan Text input capped at 40 characters (required), optional Sort Field dropdown, numeric Cycle input (required), and a Unit dropdown, each wrapped with its label and required-star pattern.

Continuing down the layout, I'm adding Call Horizon and Scheduling Indicator as optional fields, then the numeric First Call Day/Month/Year trio with their respective valid ranges (1-31, 1-12, 2020-2100), an optional Statutory Sort Field, and wrapping up with the footer section.

Now I'm moving to the Items and Editor section, laid out as two columns. On the left, an Items rail card with a header, description, and Step 2 badge, plus Add/Copy/Remove buttons and a vertical gallery of item cards showing title, FL, and tasklist fields for each item.

I need each card tappable to set the active item, but since GroupContainer doesn't natively support OnSelect and the gallery isn't marked selectable, I'm figuring out whether to overlay a transparent button on each card or find another way to capture the tap.

Actually, since Gallery does support Selectable and OnSelect, I'll set Selectable: true and OnSelect: Set(varActiveItemId, ThisItem.ItemId) on the gallery itself, then highlight the active row by comparing ThisItem.ItemId to varActiveItemId for the fill color. Now I'm moving on to the item editor card, starting with its header and description.

For the FL input, rather than building a full live-suggestions dropdown, I'm simplifying to an input field paired with a "Verify FL in SAP" button that looks up the typed code (uppercased and trimmed) against colFunctionalLocations, sets the description/metadata variables based on whether it's found, and auto-detects the plant from the FL prefix.

I'll skip the auto-suggestion dropdown to keep scope reasonable, noting this trade-off clearly in my final summary since full SAP autocomplete parity isn't practical here. Beyond the FL verification button and description field, the item fields grid needs a required short text (max 40 chars), required main work center and activity type dropdowns, and an optional object list field.

Adding remaining item fields: revision dropdown, Ørsted responsible, initials (max 12 chars), and a multiline long text input. Before finalizing, I want to check the ModernTextInput control's properties to confirm the correct way to enable multiline mode, so I'll call describe_control on it along with the dropdown and button controls to verify everything compiles correctly.

I'm noting that Gallery has "Selectable" and "Selected" listed, but OnSelect isn't explicitly shown—likely because it's an event rather than an input property, even though galleries typically support OnSelect behavior when items are tapped or Selected changes.

Since I can't confirm an explicit OnSelect for Gallery, the safer path is to mirror the existing app pattern: keep Selectable false and add explicit row-level action buttons (like Materialer's Details/Edit/Copy/Delete buttons) that set variables via their own OnSelect, rather than relying on gallery-level selection.

I'll do the same for the Items rail—add an explicit "Open"/"Select" button per card that sets varActiveItemId, following the proven working pattern. Next I want to verify ModernDropdown, ModernButton, ModernCombobox, and GroupContainer properties for completeness, especially checking if ModernCombobox with search/filter support could be a more idiomatic replacement for the JS custom autocomplete used for FL suggestions.

Naming a "vhp" prefix for all controls to avoid collisions with future screens, and setting up a small DSL with helper functions to build the control tree in a structured, readable way before generating the full script.

I'll add one more FL for each of the eight plants matching the tasklist plant codes (HCV, ASV, KYV, SKV, SMV, SSV, HEV, AVV) to ensure good coverage, then move on to writing the full generator script, simplifying some interaction patterns where needed given the scope.

Writing formula logic...

I'm trying to recall whether "Formulas" sits as a top-level sibling to "Screens" and "App" in the YAML document, rather than nested inside App, and want to verify this against the actual Power Apps YAML schema before committing to it.

Given the risk of a wasted compile cycle, I decide to skip Named Formulas entirely and instead inline the repeated formula text wherever it's needed—using Set variables for expensive or stateful logic and direct formulas for simple derived UI conditions. This sidesteps schema uncertainty entirely and guarantees the YAML compiles correctly, even if slightly more verbose.

Now I'll move on to writing the generator script itself, keeping sections manageable but complete. I'm sketching a helper function that builds the "required label + star" pattern as a small GroupContainer with a label and an optional star element bound to a required-formula, and I'm also thinking through how AutoLayout containers handle height—since Power Apps Studio doesn't auto-size these by default, heights need to be computed explicitly rather than relying on "fit to content" behavior.

Given practical constraints, I'll use fixed/approximate heights with a reasonable buffer for most containers, reserving dynamic Height formulas for cases where it really matters, like galleries whose height depends on row count times template size. AutoLayout containers will still arrange children correctly as long as the parent's declared height is at least as tall as needed, though underestimating could cause clipping or overlap.

I'm building a helper that assembles the height formula from padding, gaps, and each child's height reference, wrapped in a fallback for safety during initial load. """

"""
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, r"c:\Users\PKBJE\.copilot\session-state\e93d42be-2820-4dcf-8776-8328cfe9a7c9\files")
from gen_screen import (
    Ctrl, render, render_screen,
    C_APP_BG, C_CARD_BG, C_CARD_BORDER, C_TITLE, C_MUTED, C_REQUIRED,
    C_PRIMARY, C_PRIMARY2, C_WHITE, C_TRANSPARENT, C_INPUT_BG, C_DISABLED_BG,
    C_DIVIDER, C_VALID_FG, C_VALID_BG, C_INVALID_FG, C_INVALID_BG,
    C_INFO_FG, C_INFO_BG, C_NEUTRAL_FG, C_NEUTRAL_BG, FONT,
)

OUT_DIR = r"c:\Users\PKBJE\OneDrive - Ørsted\Documents - Sapvedligehold\SAP\SAP Site\html\powerapp-vhplan"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Generic small helpers
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def text_ctrl(name, text, size=14, color=C_TITLE, weight=None, wrap="false",
              align=None, height=20, width=None, fill=C_TRANSPARENT,
              accessible=None, visible=None, layout_min_width=None, extra=None):
    props = {
        "AccessibleLabel": accessible if accessible else text,
        "BorderStyle": "BorderStyle.None",
        "BorderThickness": "0",
        "Color": color,
        "Fill": fill,
        "Font": FONT,
        "Height": str(height),
        "PaddingBottom": "0", "PaddingLeft": "0", "PaddingRight": "0", "PaddingTop": "0",
        "Size": str(size),
        "Text": text,
        "Wrap": wrap,
    }
    if weight:
        props["FontWeight"] = f"FontWeight.{weight}"
    if align:
        props["Align"] = f"Align.{align}"
    if width is not None:
        props["Width"] = str(width)
    if visible is not None:
        props["Visible"] = visible
    if layout_min_width is not None:
        props["LayoutMinWidth"] = str(layout_min_width)
    if extra:
        props.update(extra)
    return Ctrl(name, "ModernText", props=props)


def group(name, children, direction="Vertical", gap=8, height=None, width="Parent.Width",
          align_items="Stretch", fill=None, border_color=None, border_thickness=None,
          radius=None, pad=None, fill_portions=None, wrap=None, justify=None,
          overflow_y=None, visible=None, drop_shadow="None", align_in_container=None,
          layout_min_width=None):
    props = {
        "BorderStyle": "BorderStyle.None" if not border_color else None,
        "BorderColor": border_color,
        "BorderThickness": str(border_thickness) if border_thickness is not None else ("1" if border_color else None),
        "DropShadow": f"DropShadow.{drop_shadow}",
        "LayoutAlignItems": f"LayoutAlignItems.{align_items}",
        "LayoutDirection": f"LayoutDirection.{direction}",
        "LayoutGap": str(gap),
        "LayoutMinWidth": str(layout_min_width) if layout_min_width is not None else "0",
    }
    if fill is not None:
        props["Fill"] = fill
    if fill_portions is not None:
        props["FillPortions"] = str(fill_portions)
    if height is not None:
        props["Height"] = str(height)
    if width is not None:
        props["Width"] = str(width)
    if radius is not None:
        props["RadiusBottomLeft"] = str(radius)
        props["RadiusBottomRight"] = str(radius)
        props["RadiusTopLeft"] = str(radius)
        props["RadiusTopRight"] = str(radius)
    if pad is not None:
        if isinstance(pad, tuple):
            t, r, b, l = pad
        else:
            t = r = b = l = pad
        props["PaddingTop"] = str(t)
        props["PaddingRight"] = str(r)
        props["PaddingBottom"] = str(b)
        props["PaddingLeft"] = str(l)
    if wrap is not None:
        props["LayoutWrap"] = wrap
    if justify is not None:
        props["LayoutJustifyContent"] = f"LayoutJustifyContent.{justify}"
    if overflow_y is not None:
        props["LayoutOverflowY"] = f"LayoutOverflow.{overflow_y}"
    if visible is not None:
        props["Visible"] = visible
    if align_in_container is not None:
        props["AlignInContainer"] = f"AlignInContainer.{align_in_container}"
    props = {k: v for k, v in props.items() if v is not None}
    return Ctrl(name, "GroupContainer", variant="AutoLayout", props=props, children=children)


def button(name, text, onselect, primary=False, danger=False, width=140, height=36,
           display_mode=None, base_color=None, layout_min_width=None, visible=None,
           accessible=None):
    props = {
        "AccessibleLabel": accessible if accessible else text,
        "Align": "Align.Center",
        "AlignInContainer": "AlignInContainer.Center",
        "Font": FONT,
        "FontWeight": "FontWeight.Semibold",
        "Height": str(height),
        "Layout": "ButtonLayout.TextOnly",
        "OnSelect": onselect,
        "RadiusBottomLeft": "10", "RadiusBottomRight": "10",
        "RadiusTopLeft": "10", "RadiusTopRight": "10",
        "Size": "14",
        "Text": text,
        "VerticalAlign": "VerticalAlign.Middle",
        "Width": str(width),
    }
    if danger:
        props["Appearance"] = "ButtonAppearance.Secondary"
        props["BorderColor"] = C_INVALID_FG
        props["BorderThickness"] = "1"
        props["Color"] = C_INVALID_FG
    elif primary:
        props["BasePaletteColor"] = base_color or C_PRIMARY
        props["Color"] = C_WHITE
    else:
        props["Appearance"] = "ButtonAppearance.Secondary"
        props["BorderColor"] = C_CARD_BORDER
        props["BorderThickness"] = "1"
        props["Color"] = C_TITLE
    if display_mode:

    if layout_min_width is not None:
        props["LayoutMinWidth"] = str(layout_min_width)
    if visible is not None:
        props["Visible"] = visible
    return Ctrl(name, "ModernButton", props=props)


def text_input(name, default, placeholder="\"\"", max_length=None, required_formula="false",

                onchange=None):
    props = {
        "AccessibleLabel": name,

        "BorderColor": f"If({required_formula} && IsBlank(Trim(Self.Text)), {C_REQUIRED}, {C_CARD_BORDER})",
        "BorderStyle": "BorderStyle.Solid",
        "BorderThickness": "1",
        "Color": C_TITLE,
        "Default": default,
        "Fill": C_INPUT_BG if not display_mode else f"If({display_mode} = DisplayMode.Disabled, {C_DISABLED_BG}, {C_INPUT_BG})",
        "Font": FONT,
        "Height": str(height),
        "LayoutMinWidth": "0",
        "Placeholder": placeholder,
        "RadiusBottomLeft": "10", "RadiusBottomRight": "10",
        "RadiusTopLeft": "10", "RadiusTopRight": "10",
        "Size": "14",
        "ValidationState": f"If({required_formula} && IsBlank(Trim(Self.Text)), ValidationState.Error, ValidationState.None)",
        "Width": width,
    }
    if max_length is not None:
        props["MaxLength"] = str(max_length)
    if display_mode is not None:
        props["DisplayMode"] = display_mode
    if ttype is not None:
        props["Type"] = f"TextInputType.{ttype}"
    if onchange is not None:
        props["OnChange"] = onchange
    return Ctrl(name, "ModernTextInput", props=props)


def number_input(name, default, min_v=None, max_v=None, required_formula="false",
                  width="Parent.Width", height=36, display_mode=None):
    props = {
        "AccessibleLabel": name,
        "Appearance": "Appearance.Outline",
        "BorderColor": f"If({required_formula} && IsBlank(Self.Value), {C_REQUIRED}, {C_CARD_BORDER})",
        "BorderStyle": "BorderStyle.Solid",
        "BorderThickness": "1",
        "Color": C_TITLE,
        "Default": default,
        "Fill": C_INPUT_BG,
        "Font": FONT,
        "Height": str(height),
        "LayoutMinWidth": "0",
        "Precision": "DecimalPrecision.0",
        "RadiusBottomLeft": "10", "RadiusBottomRight": "10",
        "RadiusTopLeft": "10", "RadiusTopRight": "10",
        "Size": "14",
        "ValidationState": f"If({required_formula} && IsBlank(Self.Value), ValidationState.Error, ValidationState.None)",
        "Width": width,
    }
    if min_v is not None:
        props["Min"] = str(min_v)
    if max_v is not None:
        props["Max"] = str(max_v)
    if display_mode is not None:
        props["DisplayMode"] = display_mode
    return Ctrl(name, "ModernNumberInput", props=props)


def dropdown(name, items, default, item_display="ThisItem.Value", required_formula="false",
             width="Parent.Width", height=36, display_mode=None):
    props = {
        "AccessibleLabel": name,
        "Appearance": "Appearance.Outline",
        "BorderColor": f"If({required_formula} && IsBlank(Self.Selected.Value), {C_REQUIRED}, {C_CARD_BORDER})",
        "BorderStyle": "BorderStyle.Solid",
        "BorderThickness": "1",
        "Color": C_TITLE,
        "Default": default,
        "Fill": C_INPUT_BG,
        "Font": FONT,
        "Height": str(height),
        "ItemDisplayText": item_display,
        "Items": items,
        "LayoutMinWidth": "0",
        "RadiusBottomLeft": "10", "RadiusBottomRight": "10",
        "RadiusTopLeft": "10", "RadiusTopRight": "10",
        "Size": "14",
        "ValidationState": f"If({required_formula} && IsBlank(Self.Selected.Value), ValidationState.Error, ValidationState.None)",
        "Width": width,
    }
    if display_mode is not None:
        props["DisplayMode"] = display_mode
    return Ctrl(name, "ModernDropdown", props=props)


def label_row(name, label_text, required=False, width="Parent.Width"):
    kids = [text_ctrl(f"{name}Lbl", label_text, size=13, weight="Semibold", height=20, wrap="false")]
    if required:
        kids.append(text_ctrl(f"{name}Star", "\"*\"", size=13, color=C_REQUIRED, weight="Semibold",
                               height=20, width=10, wrap="false", accessible="\"Skal udfyldes\""))
    return group(f"{name}Row", kids, direction="Horizontal", gap=3, height=20, align_items="Center", width=width)


def field_cell(name, label_text, input_ctrl, required=False, hint_text=None, width=None, height=62):

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
import sys

    field_cell, two_col_row, badge, OUT_DIR

# ===========================================================================
# HERO SECTION
# ===========================================================================

def build_hero():
    eyebrow = text_ctrl("txtVhpEyebrow", "\"VH-PLAN\"", size=12, color=C_MUTED, weight="Semibold", height=20)
    title = text_ctrl("txtVhpTitle", "\"VH-plan\"", size=28, color=C_TITLE, weight="Semibold", height=42,
                       layout_min_width=220)
    subtitle = text_ctrl(
        "txtVhpSubtitle",
        "\"Opret planheader, laas planen, tilfoej items, bind tasklist pr. item, indberet via mailkladde.\"",
        size=14, color=C_MUTED, height=40, wrap="true")

    heroLeft = group("conVhpHeroLeft", [eyebrow, title, subtitle], direction="Vertical", gap=6, height=108,
                      align_items="Stretch", fill_portions=1)

    btnValidate = button(
        "btnVhpValidate", "\"Validate\"",
        (
            "Set(varVhpPlanValidated, true);\n"
            "Set(varVhpItemValidated, true);\n"
            "Set(\n"
            "    varVhpLastValidationErrors,\n"
            "    \"Plan: \" & Text(CountRows(Filter(colVhpPlanIssueList(), true))) & \" issue(s). \" &\n"
            "    \"Items: \" & Text(CountRows(colVhpItems)) & \" total, \" &\n"
            "    Text(CountRows(Filter(colVhpItems, Status = \"invalid\"))) & \" invalid.\"\n"
            ");\n"
            "Set(\n"
            "    varVhpRuntimeInfo,\n"
            "    \"Validated: \" & CountRows(colVhpItems) & \" item(s), \" &\n"
            "    CountRows(colVhpOperations) & \" operation line(s).\"\n"

I'm planning to write the main screen builder script as a single file, "build_vhplan_screen.py," that constructs the full control tree section by section—Hero, PlanHeader, Items/Editor, Tasklist/Operations, Dispatch, floating email button, and the Tasklist Picker Modal—using helper functions like build_hero() for each piece.

Before diving into the code, I'm reviewing the underlying data model: the columns for items, operations, tasklists (with nested operation tables), functional locations, and the plan record fields like Plant, Status, PlanText, Cycle, and scheduling details, to make sure the builder script references consistent field names throughout.

Continuing the naming scheme, I'm mapping out the item editor controls for functional location, work center, activity type, and text fields, plus the tasklist dropdown and operations grid controls for the active item.

Since Power Fx resolves control references as a reactive graph rather than by textual order, I don't need to worry about defining controls before they're referenced in sibling formulas—only that names are unique and match exactly between definitions and references. With that settled, I'll move forward writing this in organized Python functions, keeping the inline dropdown count manageable.

For the operations gallery row, I'm limiting editable fields to OperationShortText, WorkHours, DurationHours, MainWorkCenter, Vendor, and LongText as text/number inputs, with OperationNo staying read-only and a Sel checkbox for removal selection. I'm also working through how Patch-on-change should behave when ThisItem comes from a Filter() result rather than the raw collection—since Patch needs ThisItem's identity to match a record in colOperations directly, this requires care given the Gallery's Items property is filtered.

This is actually a well-established pattern in Power Apps: since Filter() over a local collection preserves the underlying record identity tied to the source collection, Patch(colOperations, ThisItem, {...}) should reliably work here, so I'll move forward with writing the full script as a single long file, section by section.

I still need to seed the colFunctionalLocations table with 8 entries (SSV, SKV, HEV, HCV, ASV, AVV, KYV, SMV), one per plant used across the tasklists, using columns for Code, Description, and Plant. Time to start writing it out.

    field_cell, two_col_row, badge, OUT_DIR

# ===========================================================================
# HERO SECTION
# ===========================================================================

def build_hero():
    eyebrow = text_ctrl("txtVhpEyebrow", "\"VH-PLAN\"", size=12, color=C_MUTED, weight="Semibold", height=20)
    title = text_ctrl("txtVhpTitle", "\"VH-plan\"", size=28, color=C_TITLE, weight="Semibold", height=42,
                       layout_min_width=220)
    subtitle = text_ctrl(
        "txtVhpSubtitle",
        "\"Opret planheader, laas planen, tilfoej items, bind tasklist pr. item, indberet via mailkladde.\"",
        size=14, color=C_MUTED, height=40, wrap="true")

    heroLeft = group("conVhpHeroLeft", [eyebrow, title, subtitle], direction="Vertical", gap=6, height=108,
                      align_items="Stretch", fill_portions=1)

    btnValidate = button(
        "btnVhpValidate", "\"Validate\"",
        (
            "Set(varVhpPlanValidated, true);\n"
            "Set(varVhpItemValidated, true);\n"
            "Set(\n"
            "    varVhpRuntimeInfo,\n"
            "    \"Validated: \" & Text(CountRows(colVhpItems)) & \" item(s), \" &\n"
            "    Text(CountRows(colVhpOperations)) & \" operation line(s), \" &\n"
            "    Text(CountRows(Filter(colVhpItems, Status = \"invalid\"))) & \" invalid item(s).\"\n"
            ")"
        ),
        primary=True, width=110, height=36)

    btnExport = button(
        "btnVhpExport", "\"Export JSON\"",
        (
            "Set(\n"
            "    varVhpExportJson,\n"
            "    \"{\" &\n"
            "    \"\"\"plant\"\":\"\"\" & varVhpPlan.Plant & \"\"\",\" &\n"
            "    \"\"\"planText\"\":\"\"\" & varVhpPlan.PlanText & \"\"\",\" &\n"
            "    \"\"\"items\"\":\" & Text(CountRows(colVhpItems)) & \",\" &\n"
            "    \"\"\"operations\"\":\" & Text(CountRows(colVhpOperations)) &\n"
            "    \"}\"\n"
            ");\n"
            "Set(varVhpRuntimeInfo, \"JSON exported: \" & Text(CountRows(colVhpItems)) & \" item(s), \" & Text(Len(varVhpExportJson)) & \" characters.\")"
        ),
        primary=False, width=130, height=36)

    actionsRow = group("conVhpHeroActionsRow", [btnValidate, btnExport], direction="Horizontal", gap=10,
                        height=36, justify="End", width=250)
    heroActions = group("conVhpHeroActions", [actionsRow], direction="Vertical", gap=8, height=36,
                         align_items="End", width=250)

    heroGrid = group("conVhpHeroGrid", [heroLeft, heroActions], direction="Horizontal", gap=16, height=108,
                      wrap="true")

    step_defs = [
        ("txtVhpStep1", "\"1. Plan\"", "true"),
        ("txtVhpStep2", "\"2. Item\"", "varVhpPlanCommitted"),
        ("txtVhpStep3", "\"3. Tasklist\"", "varVhpPlanCommitted && CountRows(colVhpItems) > 0"),
        ("txtVhpStep4", "\"4. Operations\"",
         "varVhpPlanCommitted && !IsBlank(LookUp(colVhpItems, ItemId = varVhpActiveItemId, TasklistKey))"),
        ("txtVhpStep5", "\"5. Dispatch\"",
         "varVhpPlanCommitted && CountRows(colVhpOperations) > 0"),
    ]
    steps = []
    for nm, lbl, active_formula in step_defs:
        steps.append(text_ctrl(
            nm, lbl, size=12, weight="Semibold", height=26, width=118, wrap="false",
            extra={
                "Align": "Align.Center",
                "AlignInContainer": "AlignInContainer.Center",
                "Color": f"If({active_formula}, {C_WHITE}, {C_MUTED})",
                "Fill": f"If({active_formula}, {C_PRIMARY}, {C_NEUTRAL_BG})",
                "PaddingLeft": "8", "PaddingRight": "8",
                "RadiusBottomLeft": "14", "RadiusBottomRight": "14",
                "RadiusTopLeft": "14", "RadiusTopRight": "14",
            }))
    processStrip = group("conVhpProcessStrip", steps, direction="Horizontal", gap=8, height=26, wrap="true")

    runtimeInfo = text_ctrl("txtVhpRuntimeInfo", "varVhpRuntimeInfo", size=13, color=C_MUTED, height=36, wrap="true")

    legendStar = text_ctrl("txtVhpLegendStar", "\"*\"", size=13, color=C_REQUIRED, weight="Semibold", height=20,
                            width=10, wrap="false")
    legendText = text_ctrl("txtVhpLegendText", "\"Skal udfyldes\"", size=13, color=C_MUTED, height=20, width=110,
                            wrap="false")
    legend = group("conVhpLegend", [legendStar, legendText], direction="Horizontal", gap=3, height=20,
                   align_items="Center", width=110)

    hero = group(
        "conVhpHero", [heroGrid, processStrip, runtimeInfo, legend], direction="Vertical", gap=12,
        height=108 + 12 + 26 + 12 + 36 + 12 + 20 + 32,
        fill=C_CARD_BG, border_color=C_CARD_BORDER, radius=14, pad=(16, 16, 16, 16))
    return hero

data.reasoningText:
I catch myself overcomplicating the conditional expression there — I'll just simplify and set the layout direction to "Horizontal" directly with wrap enabled, avoiding that confusing self-referential logic.

Since children wrap naturally when width is limited, that handles responsiveness without needing conditional direction. I also want to revisit the Height formula for the hero section—I mixed a conditional If() with plain arithmetic additions, which is valid Power Fx but conceptually messy, so I should simplify those height calculations cleanly rather than leaving ad hoc guesswork, especially since exact pixel heights aren't critical for a scrollable layout.

Since the container sits inside a vertical auto-layout with scroll enabled at the root, even if my height estimate is a bit off, the content will still scroll properly rather than clip.

Given the effort tradeoff, I'll drop the wrap-based approach and instead just switch the direction of the hero grid conditionally based on screen width inline, and set height with a simple formula like "If(App.Width < 900, 108+12+36, 108)" rather than trying to build a reusable named breakpoint variable.

I'll keep things simple with fixed heights and only trivial responsive touches like text wrapping, staying consistent with the established colors, fonts, spacing, and radii even without pixel-perfect responsiveness. Now let me rewrite build_hero cleanly with these fixed heights.

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, r"c:\Users\PKBJE\.copilot\session-state\e93d42be-2820-4dcf-8776-8328cfe9a7c9\files")
from gen_screen import Ctrl, C_CARD_BG, C_CARD_BORDER, C_TITLE, C_MUTED, C_REQUIRED, C_PRIMARY, C_WHITE, \
    C_INFO_FG, C_INFO_BG, C_NEUTRAL_FG, C_NEUTRAL_BG, FONT
from build_helpers import text_ctrl, group, button, text_input, number_input, dropdown, label_row, \
    field_cell, two_col_row, badge

DM_PLAN = "If(varVhpPlanLocked, DisplayMode.Disabled, DisplayMode.Edit)"
REQ_PLAN = "varVhpPlanValidated"


def section_header(name, title, desc, step_label):
    t = text_ctrl(f"{name}Title", f"\"{title}\"", size=19, weight="Semibold", height=26, wrap="false")
    d = text_ctrl(f"{name}Desc", f"\"{desc}\"", size=13, color=C_MUTED, height=20, wrap="false")
    left = group(f"{name}Left", [t, d], direction="Vertical", gap=2, height=48, fill_portions=1)
    right = badge(f"{name}Badge", f"\"{step_label}\"", width=64)
    return group(f"{name}", [left, right], direction="Horizontal", gap=12, height=48, align_items="Center")


def build_plan_header():
    header = section_header("conVhpPlanHead", "Plan Header",
                             "Vedligeholdelsesplanens stamdata og tidsparametre.", "Step 1")

    lockState = text_ctrl(
        "txtVhpPlanLockState",
        "If(varVhpPlanLocked, \"Plan locked: \" & varVhpPlan.Plant & \" \" & varVhpPlan.PlanText & \" (\" & varVhpPlan.Status & \"). Click Edit to make changes.\", \"Plan is open for editing.\")",
        size=13, color=f"If(varVhpPlanLocked, {C_INFO_FG}, {C_MUTED})", height=20, wrap="true",
        extra={"Fill": f"If(varVhpPlanLocked, {C_INFO_BG}, {C_NEUTRAL_BG})", "PaddingLeft": "10",
               "PaddingRight": "10", "PaddingTop": "4", "PaddingBottom": "4",
               "RadiusBottomLeft": "8", "RadiusBottomRight": "8", "RadiusTopLeft": "8", "RadiusTopRight": "8"})

    drpPlant = dropdown("drpVhpPlant", "colVhpPlantCodes", "LookUp(colVhpPlantCodes, Value = varVhpPlan.Plant)",
                         item_display="ThisItem.Value", required_formula=REQ_PLAN, display_mode=DM_PLAN)
    drpStatus = dropdown("drpVhpStatus", "colVhpPlanStatusOptions",
                          "LookUp(colVhpPlanStatusOptions, Value = varVhpPlan.Status)",
                          required_formula=REQ_PLAN, display_mode=DM_PLAN)
    txtPlanText = text_input("txtVhpPlanText", "varVhpPlan.PlanText", max_length=40,
                              required_formula=REQ_PLAN, display_mode=DM_PLAN)
    drpSortField = dropdown("drpVhpSortField", "colVhpSortFieldOptions",
                             "LookUp(colVhpSortFieldOptions, Value = varVhpPlan.SortField)",
                             display_mode=DM_PLAN)
    numCycle = number_input("numVhpCycle", "varVhpPlan.Cycle", min_v=1, required_formula=REQ_PLAN,
                             display_mode=DM_PLAN)
    drpUnit = dropdown("drpVhpUnit", "colVhpUnitOptions", "LookUp(colVhpUnitOptions, Value = varVhpPlan.Unit)",
                        required_formula=REQ_PLAN, display_mode=DM_PLAN)
    drpCallHorizon = dropdown("drpVhpCallHorizon", "colVhpCallHorizonOptions",
                               "LookUp(colVhpCallHorizonOptions, Value = varVhpPlan.CallHorizon)",
                               display_mode=DM_PLAN)
    txtSchedInd = text_input("txtVhpSchedInd", "varVhpPlan.SchedulingIndicator", display_mode=DM_PLAN)
    numFirstCallDay = number_input("numVhpFirstCallDay", "varVhpPlan.FirstCallDay", min_v=1, max_v=31,
                                    required_formula=REQ_PLAN, display_mode=DM_PLAN)
    numFirstCallMonth = number_input("numVhpFirstCallMonth", "varVhpPlan.FirstCallMonth", min_v=1, max_v=12,
                                      required_formula=REQ_PLAN, display_mode=DM_PLAN)
    numFirstCallYear = number_input("numVhpFirstCallYear", "varVhpPlan.FirstCallYear", min_v=2020, max_v=2100,
                                     required_formula=REQ_PLAN, display_mode=DM_PLAN)
    txtStatutorySortField = text_input("txtVhpStatutorySortField", "varVhpPlan.StatutorySortField",
                                        display_mode=DM_PLAN)

    row1 = two_col_row("conVhpPlanRow1",
                        field_cell("conVhpCellPlant", "Plant", drpPlant, required=True),
                        field_cell("conVhpCellStatus", "Status", drpStatus, required=True))
    row2 = two_col_row("conVhpPlanRow2",
                        field_cell("conVhpCellPlanText", "Plan Text", txtPlanText, required=True),
                        field_cell("conVhpCellSortField", "Sort Field", drpSortField))
    row3 = two_col_row("conVhpPlanRow3",
                        field_cell("conVhpCellCycle", "Cycle", numCycle, required=True),
                        field_cell("conVhpCellUnit", "Unit", drpUnit, required=True))
    row4 = two_col_row("conVhpPlanRow4",
                        field_cell("conVhpCellCallHorizon", "Call Horizon", drpCallHorizon),
                        field_cell("conVhpCellSchedInd", "Scheduling Indicator", txtSchedInd))
    row5 = two_col_row("conVhpPlanRow5",
                        field_cell("conVhpCellFirstCallDay", "First Call Day", numFirstCallDay, required=True),
                        field_cell("conVhpCellFirstCallMonth", "First Call Month", numFirstCallMonth, required=True))
    row6 = two_col_row("conVhpPlanRow6",
                        field_cell("conVhpCellFirstCallYear", "First Call Year", numFirstCallYear, required=True),
                        field_cell("conVhpCellStatutorySortField", "Statutory Sort Field", txtStatutorySortField))

    grid = group("conVhpPlanGrid", [row1, row2, row3, row4, row5, row6], direction="Vertical", gap=16,
                 height="If(App.Width < 640, 6 * (2 * 62 + 20) + 5 * 16, 6 * 62 + 5 * 16)")

    planMeta = text_ctrl(
        "txtVhpPlanMeta",
        "If(varVhpPlanCommitted, \"Plan created \" & Text(varVhpPlanCreatedAt, \"dd-mm-yyyy hh:mm\"), \"\")",
        size=12, color=C_MUTED, height=18, wrap="false")
    optionsState = text_ctrl(
        "txtVhpPlanOptionsState",
        "\"Reference lists loaded: 13 option lists, \" & Text(CountRows(colVhpTasklists)) & \" tasklists, \" & Text(CountRows(colVhpFunctionalLocations)) & \" functional locations (offline data).\"",
        size=12, color=C_MUTED, height=18, wrap="true")
    footerInfo = group("conVhpPlanFooterInfo", [planMeta, optionsState], direction="Vertical", gap=2, height=40,
                       fill_portions=1)

    btnSave = button(
        "btnVhpPlanSave", "If(varVhpPlanLocked, \"Edit\", \"Save\")",
        (
            "If(\n"
            "    varVhpPlanLocked,\n"
            "    Set(varVhpPlanLocked, false);\n"
            "    Set(varVhpRuntimeInfo, \"Plan unlocked for editing.\"),\n"
            "\n"
            "    Set(varVhpPlanValidated, true);\n"
            "    If(\n"
            "        IsBlank(drpVhpPlant.Selected.Value) ||\n"
            "        IsBlank(drpVhpStatus.Selected.Value) ||\n"
            "        IsBlank(Trim(txtVhpPlanText.Text)) || Len(Trim(txtVhpPlanText.Text)) > 40 ||\n"
            "        IsBlank(numVhpCycle.Value) || numVhpCycle.Value <= 0 ||\n"
            "        IsBlank(drpVhpUnit.Selected.Value) ||\n"
            "        IsBlank(numVhpFirstCallDay.Value) || numVhpFirstCallDay.Value < 1 || numVhpFirstCallDay.Value > 31 ||\n"
            "        IsBlank(numVhpFirstCallMonth.Value) || numVhpFirstCallMonth.Value < 1 || numVhpFirstCallMonth.Value > 12 ||\n"
            "        IsBlank(numVhpFirstCallYear.Value) || numVhpFirstCallYear.Value < 2020 || numVhpFirstCallYear.Value > 2100,\n"
            "        Set(varVhpRuntimeInfo, \"Plan contains issues. Fix plan fields before creating items.\"),\n"
            "\n"
            "        Set(\n"
            "            varVhpPlan,\n"
            "            {\n"
            "                Plant: drpVhpPlant.Selected.Value,\n"
            "                Status: drpVhpStatus.Selected.Value,\n"
            "                PlanText: Trim(txtVhpPlanText.Text),\n"
            "                SortField: drpVhpSortField.Selected.Value,\n"
            "                Cycle: numVhpCycle.Value,\n"
            "                Unit: drpVhpUnit.Selected.Value,\n"
            "                CallHorizon: drpVhpCallHorizon.Selected.Value,\n"
            "                SchedulingIndicator: Trim(txtVhpSchedInd.Text),\n"
            "                FirstCallDay: numVhpFirstCallDay.Value,\n"
            "                FirstCallMonth: numVhpFirstCallMonth.Value,\n"
            "                FirstCallYear: numVhpFirstCallYear.Value,\n"
            "                StatutorySortField: Trim(txtVhpStatutorySortField.Text)\n"
            "            }\n"
            "        );\n"
            "        Set(varVhpPlanCommitted, true);\n"
            "        Set(varVhpPlanLocked, true);\n"
            "        Set(varVhpPlanCreatedAt, Now());\n"
            "        Set(varVhpRuntimeInfo, \"Plan saved and locked: \" & drpVhpPlant.Selected.Value & \" \" & Trim(txtVhpPlanText.Text) & \".\")\n"
            "    )\n"
            ")"
        ),
        primary=True, width=140, height=36)

    footer = group("conVhpPlanFooter", [footerInfo, btnSave], direction="Horizontal", gap=16, height=40,
                   align_items="Center")

    card = group("conVhpPlanCard", [header, lockState, grid, footer], direction="Vertical", gap=14,
                 height=48 + 14 + 28 + 14 + (6 * 62 + 5 * 16) + 14 + 40 + 40,
                 fill=C_CARD_BG, border_color=C_CARD_BORDER, radius=14, pad=(18, 18, 18, 18))
    return card

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, r"c:\Users\PKBJE\.copilot\session-state\e93d42be-2820-4dcf-8776-8328cfe9a7c9\files")
from gen_screen import Ctrl, C_CARD_BG, C_CARD_BORDER, C_TITLE, C_MUTED, C_REQUIRED, C_PRIMARY, C_WHITE, \
    C_INFO_FG, C_INFO_BG, C_NEUTRAL_FG, C_NEUTRAL_BG, FONT
from build_helpers import text_ctrl, group, button, text_input, number_input, dropdown, label_row, \
    field_cell, two_col_row, badge

DM_PLAN = "If(varVhpPlanLocked, DisplayMode.Disabled, DisplayMode.Edit)"
REQ_PLAN = "varVhpPlanValidated"


def section_header(name, title, desc, step_label):
    t = text_ctrl(f"{name}Title", f"\"{title}\"", size=19, weight="Semibold", height=26, wrap="false")
    d = text_ctrl(f"{name}Desc", f"\"{desc}\"", size=13, color=C_MUTED, height=20, wrap="false")
    left = group(f"{name}Left", [t, d], direction="Vertical", gap=2, height=48, fill_portions=1)
    right = badge(f"{name}Badge", f"\"{step_label}\"", width=64)
    return group(f"{name}", [left, right], direction="Horizontal", gap=12, height=48, align_items="Center")


def build_plan_header():
    header = section_header("conVhpPlanHead", "Plan Header",
                             "Vedligeholdelsesplanens stamdata og tidsparametre.", "Step 1")

    lockState = text_ctrl(
        "txtVhpPlanLockState",
        "If(varVhpPlanLocked, \"Plan locked: \" & varVhpPlan.Plant & \" \" & varVhpPlan.PlanText & \" (\" & varVhpPlan.Status & \"). Click Edit to make changes.\", \"Plan is open for editing.\")",
        size=13, color=f"If(varVhpPlanLocked, {C_INFO_FG}, {C_MUTED})", height=20, wrap="true",
        extra={"Fill": f"If(varVhpPlanLocked, {C_INFO_BG}, {C_NEUTRAL_BG})", "PaddingLeft": "10",
               "PaddingRight": "10", "PaddingTop": "4", "PaddingBottom": "4",
               "RadiusBottomLeft": "8", "RadiusBottomRight": "8", "RadiusTopLeft": "8", "RadiusTopRight": "8"})

    drpPlant = dropdown("drpVhpPlant", "colVhpPlantCodes", "LookUp(colVhpPlantCodes, Value = varVhpPlan.Plant)",
                         item_display="ThisItem.Value", required_formula=REQ_PLAN, display_mode=DM_PLAN)
    drpStatus = dropdown("drpVhpStatus", "colVhpPlanStatusOptions",
                          "LookUp(colVhpPlanStatusOptions, Value = varVhpPlan.Status)",
                          required_formula=REQ_PLAN, display_mode=DM_PLAN)
    txtPlanText = text_input("txtVhpPlanText", "varVhpPlan.PlanText", max_length=40,
                              required_formula=REQ_PLAN, display_mode=DM_PLAN)
    drpSortField = dropdown("drpVhpSortField", "colVhpSortFieldOptions",
                             "LookUp(colVhpSortFieldOptions, Value = varVhpPlan.SortField)",
                             display_mode=DM_PLAN)
    numCycle = number_input("numVhpCycle", "varVhpPlan.Cycle", min_v=1, required_formula=REQ_PLAN,
                             display_mode=DM_PLAN)
    drpUnit = dropdown("drpVhpUnit", "colVhpUnitOptions", "LookUp(colVhpUnitOptions, Value = varVhpPlan.Unit)",
                        required_formula=REQ_PLAN, display_mode=DM_PLAN)
    drpCallHorizon = dropdown("drpVhpCallHorizon", "colVhpCallHorizonOptions",
                               "LookUp(colVhpCallHorizonOptions, Value = varVhpPlan.CallHorizon)",
                               display_mode=DM_PLAN)
    txtSchedInd = text_input("txtVhpSchedInd", "varVhpPlan.SchedulingIndicator", display_mode=DM_PLAN)
    numFirstCallDay = number_input("numVhpFirstCallDay", "varVhpPlan.FirstCallDay", min_v=1, max_v=31,
                                    required_formula=REQ_PLAN, display_mode=DM_PLAN)
    numFirstCallMonth = number_input("numVhpFirstCallMonth", "varVhpPlan.FirstCallMonth", min_v=1, max_v=12,
                                      required_formula=REQ_PLAN, display_mode=DM_PLAN)
    numFirstCallYear = number_input("numVhpFirstCallYear", "varVhpPlan.FirstCallYear", min_v=2020, max_v=2100,
                                     required_formula=REQ_PLAN, display_mode=DM_PLAN)
    txtStatutorySortField = text_input("txtVhpStatutorySortField", "varVhpPlan.StatutorySortField",
                                        display_mode=DM_PLAN)

    row1 = two_col_row("conVhpPlanRow1",
                        field_cell("conVhpCellPlant", "Plant", drpPlant, required=True),
                        field_cell("conVhpCellStatus", "Status", drpStatus, required=True))
    row2 = two_col_row("conVhpPlanRow2",
                        field_cell("conVhpCellPlanText", "Plan Text", txtPlanText, required=True),
                        field_cell("conVhpCellSortField", "Sort Field", drpSortField))
    row3 = two_col_row("conVhpPlanRow3",
                        field_cell("conVhpCellCycle", "Cycle", numCycle, required=True),
                        field_cell("conVhpCellUnit", "Unit", drpUnit, required=True))
    row4 = two_col_row("conVhpPlanRow4",
                        field_cell("conVhpCellCallHorizon", "Call Horizon", drpCallHorizon),
                        field_cell("conVhpCellSchedInd", "Scheduling Indicator", txtSchedInd))
    row5 = two_col_row("conVhpPlanRow5",
                        field_cell("conVhpCellFirstCallDay", "First Call Day", numFirstCallDay, required=True),
                        field_cell("conVhpCellFirstCallMonth", "First Call Month", numFirstCallMonth, required=True))
    row6 = two_col_row("conVhpPlanRow6",
                        field_cell("conVhpCellFirstCallYear", "First Call Year", numFirstCallYear, required=True),
                        field_cell("conVhpCellStatutorySortField", "Statutory Sort Field", txtStatutorySortField))

    grid = group("conVhpPlanGrid", [row1, row2, row3, row4, row5, row6], direction="Vertical", gap=16,
                 height="If(App.Width < 640, 6 * (2 * 62 + 20) + 5 * 16, 6 * 62 + 5 * 16)")

    planMeta = text_ctrl(
        "txtVhpPlanMeta",
        "If(varVhpPlanCommitted, \"Plan created \" & Text(varVhpPlanCreatedAt, \"dd-mm-yyyy hh:mm\"), \"\")",
        size=12, color=C_MUTED, height=18, wrap="false")
    optionsState = text_ctrl(
        "txtVhpPlanOptionsState",
        "\"Reference lists loaded: 13 option lists, \" & Text(CountRows(colVhpTasklists)) & \" tasklists, \" & Text(CountRows(colVhpFunctionalLocations)) & \" functional locations (offline data).\"",
        size=12, color=C_MUTED, height=18, wrap="true")
    footerInfo = group("conVhpPlanFooterInfo", [planMeta, optionsState], direction="Vertical", gap=2, height=40,
                       fill_portions=1)

    btnSave = button(
        "btnVhpPlanSave", "If(varVhpPlanLocked, \"Edit\", \"Save\")",
        (
            "If(\n"
            "    varVhpPlanLocked,\n"
            "    Set(varVhpPlanLocked, false);\n"
            "    Set(varVhpRuntimeInfo, \"Plan unlocked for editing.\"),\n"
            "\n"
            "    Set(varVhpPlanValidated, true);\n"
            "    If(\n"
            "        IsBlank(drpVhpPlant.Selected.Value) ||\n"
            "        IsBlank(drpVhpStatus.Selected.Value) ||\n"
            "        IsBlank(Trim(txtVhpPlanText.Text)) || Len(Trim(txtVhpPlanText.Text)) > 40 ||\n"
            "        IsBlank(numVhpCycle.Value) || numVhpCycle.Value <= 0 ||\n"
            "        IsBlank(drpVhpUnit.Selected.Value) ||\n"
            "        IsBlank(numVhpFirstCallDay.Value) || numVhpFirstCallDay.Value < 1 || numVhpFirstCallDay.Value > 31 ||\n"
            "        IsBlank(numVhpFirstCallMonth.Value) || numVhpFirstCallMonth.Value < 1 || numVhpFirstCallMonth.Value > 12 ||\n"
            "        IsBlank(numVhpFirstCallYear.Value) || numVhpFirstCallYear.Value < 2020 || numVhpFirstCallYear.Value > 2100,\n"
            "        Set(varVhpRuntimeInfo, \"Plan contains issues. Fix plan fields before creating items.\"),\n"
            "\n"
            "        Set(\n"
            "            varVhpPlan,\n"
            "            {\n"
            "                Plant: drpVhpPlant.Selected.Value,\n"
            "                Status: drpVhpStatus.Selected.Value,\n"
            "                PlanText: Trim(txtVhpPlanText.Text),\n"
            "                SortField: drpVhpSortField.Selected.Value,\n"
            "                Cycle: numVhpCycle.Value,\n"
            "                Unit: drpVhpUnit.Selected.Value,\n"
            "                CallHorizon: drpVhpCallHorizon.Selected.Value,\n"
            "                SchedulingIndicator: Trim(txtVhpSchedInd.Text),\n"
            "                FirstCallDay: numVhpFirstCallDay.Value,\n"
            "                FirstCallMonth: numVhpFirstCallMonth.Value,\n"
            "                FirstCallYear: numVhpFirstCallYear.Value,\n"
            "                StatutorySortField: Trim(txtVhpStatutorySortField.Text)\n"
            "            }\n"
            "        );\n"
            "        Set(varVhpPlanCommitted, true);\n"
            "        Set(varVhpPlanLocked, true);\n"
            "        Set(varVhpPlanCreatedAt, Now());\n"
            "        Set(varVhpRuntimeInfo, \"Plan saved and locked: \" & drpVhpPlant.Selected.Value & \" \" & Trim(txtVhpPlanText.Text) & \".\")\n"
            "    )\n"
            ")"
        ),
        primary=True, width=140, height=36)

    footer = group("conVhpPlanFooter", [footerInfo, btnSave], direction="Horizontal", gap=16, height=40,
                   align_items="Center")

    card = group("conVhpPlanCard", [header, lockState, grid, footer], direction="Vertical", gap=14,
                 height=48 + 14 + 28 + 14 + (6 * 62 + 5 * 16) + 14 + 40 + 40,
                 fill=C_CARD_BG, border_color=C_CARD_BORDER, radius=14, pad=(18, 18, 18, 18))
    return card
